lesson.title: Taharah: wudu and what breaks it (Shafi'i)
lesson.text: Taharah is the key to solat. In the Shafi'i school the obligatory parts (fardhu) of wudu are six: intention while washing the face, washing the face, washing the hands to the elbows, wiping part of the head, washing the feet to the ankles, and doing them in order (Matn Abi Shuja'). Wudu breaks by anything leaving the front or back passage, sleep not seated firmly, loss of mind, and touching the private part with the palm. Notably, in the Shafi'i school skin-to-skin touch with the opposite sex (non-mahram) also breaks wudu. Fasting follows the same care: intention each night for Ramadan, and for a sunnah fast it can be made before Zuhur.

name.text: He rewards a small deed many times over and thanks His servants for their effort. Your patience at work is seen and repaid by the One who appreciates.
He arranges unseen kindnesses in ways you do not notice. Tonight, recall one ease that arrived quietly today and say Alhamdulillah.

quote.text: Thank the Almighty, no matter what the circumstances. It's not just to do with wealth & good things. Thank Him for guiding you & keeping you steadfast. Thank Him for increase in knowledge, for the lessons you've learnt from hardship. Do this each day and He will grant you more.

world.text: Bulletin of the Atomic Scientists set it at 85 seconds to midnight on 27 Jan 2026, the closest ever, citing nuclear risk, AI and great-power rivalry.
Forecasters' chance of a 'World War Three' before 2050 (10M+ deaths, major powers involved).
Prof Jiang's latest lectures on geopolitics and where great-power conflict is heading.

Nuclear deterrence makes all-out war a losing move for every major power, so the stable outcome (flashing) is 'compete, don't fight': trade wars, arms races and proxy conflicts. The real danger is a misread in a crisis like Taiwan or Ukraine, which is why the clock and the forecast are rising. Meter: 2 of 5.
